STUDIO ROSTER Lived Experience & Clinical Mastery

Curated Guests

We invite neuroscientists, trauma clinicians, palliative doctors, and everyday people who have navigated the darkest corners of human experience with grace.

NEUROSCIENCE

Dr. Kenji Sato, MD, PhD

Director of Cognitive Resilience Institute

Pioneer in polyvagal research and autonomic nervous system rehabilitation. Dr. Sato has spent twenty years studying secondary traumatic stress among emergency room surgeons, combat medics, and humanitarian workers.

“When caring hurts, it does not mean your heart is too soft. It means your nervous system is sounding an alarm that has been ignored for too long.”
Featured in Ep #109
FAMILY SYSTEMS

Dr. Elena Rostova, PsyD

Clinical Psychologist & Author

Specialist in ambiguous loss and relational estrangement. Dr. Rostova helps adult children and parents navigate complex intergenerational boundaries without succumbing to debilitating guilt.

“Estrangement is rarely an act of cruelty. Almost always, it is an act of sheer psychological survival.”
Featured in Ep #107
BEREAVEMENT

Samuel Osei

Author of 'The Architecture of Grief'

Following the sudden loss of his 16-year-old son, Samuel founded the Fathers in Mourning circle. He writes candidly about the suffocating pressure placed on men to remain emotionally numb in times of tragedy.

“Grief is love with no place to go. When men are told not to cry, that love turns to poison inside our chests.”
Featured in Ep #106
SOMATIC CAREER

Carlos Vega

Somatic Strategist & Former Creative Director

After a life-threatening cardiac event at age 34 from chronic 80-hour workweeks, Carlos retrained in somatic psychology to help professionals dismantle workaholism and reclaim genuine rest.

“Burnout is not resolved by a two-week vacation to Bali. It is resolved by renegotiating your relationship to your own mortality.”
Featured in Ep #104
NEURODIVERGENCE

Dr. Leanne Thorne, PhD

Neurodivergent Clinician & Researcher

Dr. Thorne specializes in adult late-diagnosis ADHD and autism spectrum masking in women and gender-expansive individuals, guiding clients from shame into somatic self-acceptance.

“The relief of finally knowing you are not fundamentally broken, but simply operating with an alternative nervous system wiring, is indescribable.”
Featured in Ep #103
END-OF-LIFE CARE

Dr. Jordan Chen, MD

Palliative Physician & Hospice Medical Director

Having accompanied more than a thousand human beings through their final hours, Dr. Chen shares the universal truths people whisper when social pretenses are stripped away.

“No one on their deathbed has ever asked to see their quarterly performance review. They only ask: Was I loved? Did I forgive enough?”
Featured in Ep #098
GUEST CASTING

Would you like to sit across the table from Maya & Marcus?

We welcome licensed practitioners, researchers, memoirists, and courageous individuals with lived experience. Our studio is an emotionally safe, non-exploitative environment.
